messages.subject: Problems with Spam......
messages.body_plain:
Given a recent spate of spam on this discussion group I have changed
the group to have new members vetted on joining and for new members
postings to be moderated.

Sorry for the spate of objectionable spam recently. I hope this will
abate the tide there.

Regards,
Graham
